fields.briefDescription: Build synthetic Audiences and run Studies for concept testing, message testing, and segment comparison with Minds.
fields.testingInstructions: Connect the remote HTTPS MCP server at https://getminds.ai/mcp using your own Minds account through OAuth. Review https://getminds.ai/mcp/setup. Discover tools, read account allowances and research methods, then follow integrations/grok-bot/review-checklist.md in https://github.com/minds-ai-co/minds-mcp. Test the reviewed research workflow in a dedicated QA workspace. Each importer authenticates their own account; no creator credentials are included.

remainingRequirements: Complete the Grok Bot in-app test using an eligible signed-in account.
Check whether the existing Cursor publisher review can include Grok Bot before sending a potentially duplicate plugin application.
Publish and inspect the sanitized Bot template separately; MCP plugin review does not establish a Bot catalog listing.
Supply publisher contact details and review the current publisher terms at submission time.
